page.overview:
Who is Bregil?

Bregil was an Edain woman of the House of Bëor.

Bregil was born in the year FA 386 to Bregor, and was the elder sister of Hirwen, Bregolas, Gilwen, and Barahir. She later married Arachon, to whom she bore Brandir and Beldis.

It is possible that the name Bregil means "Lively Star", from the Sindarin words Bregol, meaning 'quick', or 'lively', and gil, meaning 'star'.
